content: चारु {%a.%} (-रु|-र्वी|{%f.%}) [चरति चित्ते चर् उण् <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Uṇ. 1. 3.</ls>] .²1 Agreeable, welcome, beloved, esteemed, dear (with <ab>dat.</ab> or <ab>loc.</ab>); वरुणाय or वरुणे चारुः. .²2 Pleasing, lovely, beautiful, elegant, pretty; प्रिये चारुशीले मुञ्च मयि मानमनिदानम् <ls>Gīt. 10</ls>; सर्वं प्रिये चारुतरं वसन्ते <ls>Ṛs. 6. 2</ls>; चकासतं चारु चमूरुचर्मणा <ls>Śi. 1. 8</ls>, <ls n="Śi.">4. 49</ls>. .{@-रुः@} An epithet of Bṛhaspati. .{@-रु@} {%n.%} Saffron.
चार्वी .²1 A beautiful woman. .²2 Moonlight. .²3 Intelligence. .²4 Splendour, lustre, brilliancy. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of the wife of Kubera.
